mutations.name: the repair starts from the split alone, with no still seed
kills: the split as the repair's starting script the still seed starts the repair on the split, never as its answer

mutations.name: a claim-card's claim needs its own cue, so a cue-less reply is refused
kills: the split as the repair's starting script a repaired split is kept only when it beats the seed

mutations.name: a model reply is not held by code
kills: a reply that leaves the closing button still is held by code and kept

mutations.name: a seed keeps its orphan cues
mutations.replace: ({ script: planned(seed, plan), moves: [] as string[] })
kills: an orphan cue target is dropped from a seed by code, so a seed whose only fault it was makes no model call

mutations.name: a drafted reply keeps its orphan cues
kills: an orphan cue target is dropped from a drafted reply before its plan check, so it costs no plan retry
